subject: prd/argus
statement: While a problem is parked on an unanswered decision brief — or any driven item (a stage escalation awaiting Argus, an unclaimed tracker item) exceeds its configured age — the delivery ledger shall expose the age, and when a threshold is crossed at a drive touchpoint, Argus shall raise the item's visibility on its tracker surface (label or comment per repo config).
rationale: parks and aging items get louder, never quieter, at both spine levels; Argus is the outermost flow — nothing else alarms its briefs; event-driven at touchpoints, so the parked state's steady-state cost is zero (a session-form agent that is not running spends nothing; the bump fires at the next touch) (brainstorm:autonomous-developer#D-8)
fit_criterion: a seeded park older than threshold triggers exactly one visibility bump at the next touchpoint
